sentences.text: Lab Report: Text classification with neural networks
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
Each experiment was repeated 5 times with different random seeds.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 24 GB of memory.
Figure 1 shows the validation accuracy of GRU by dataset.
As shown in Figure 1, on SST-2, GRU obtains a validation accuracy of 72.0%.
GRU scores 20.5 points higher on SST-2 than on MNIST.
On MNIST, GRU obtains a validation accuracy of 74%.
Figure 2 shows the validation accuracy of EfficientNet by dataset.
EfficientNet scores 17.2 points higher on Fashion-MNIST than on SVHN.
On SVHN, EfficientNet obtains a validation accuracy of 88.1%.
Figure 3 shows the accuracy of MobileNet by dataset.
MobileNet scores 53.2 points higher on AG News than on MNIST.
On IMDB, Logistic Regression obtains an accuracy of 80.3%.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
